title: DOOM Zero
summary: 🔥 DOOM Zero: pocket-sized Hell, custom controls & a bloody secret! 😈
description:
# 🔥 WELCOME TO HELL. IT FITS IN YOUR POCKET! 😈💀

## 320 × 170 PIXELS OF ABSOLUTE DISRESPECT! 🩸🔥

**DOOM Zero** turns your **Cardputer Zero** into a tiny doorway to pixelated Hell! 🎮🔥 One gritty, blood-red launcher. Multiple classic DOOM entries. A suspicious UAC terminal. And a demon with absolutely zero customer-service training. 😂👹

### 🎮 ONE LAUNCHER. MANY WAYS TO FIND TROUBLE.
Browse classic DOOM entries and supported WAD-based adventures from a single hellish menu. **DOOM (1993)** gets past the *name-check* without a riddle — because legends don't queue. 😎 You still need the game files you're entitled to use.

### 🔐 A SECRET ONLY A TRUE MARINE SHOULD KNOW...
The other protected doors are guarded by a UAC security question. Your mission: **know your Marine's name**. Here's a hint: *even the old DOOM novels have something to say about him*. 🤫📖

Get it wrong? **HELL REJECTED YOU!** 💥🩸 A flying fireball, a screen full of animated blood, and an unforgettable personal review from Hell's least-qualified receptionist:

**“WRONG NAME, ROOKIE! EVEN AN IMP KNOWS THAT!”** 🤣💀

No spoilers. Study the lore, Marine. 🔥

### ⌨️ YOUR KEYS. YOUR RULES.
The mandatory **UAC MARINE TRAINING** guides first-time players through assigning their own movement, turning, firing and door-use keys, one step at a time. Save your choices and adjust them later in **Settings > Controls**. Your keyboard, your battlefield! 🫡🎯

### 🩸 TINY SCREEN. BIG DOOM ENERGY.
Dark industrial metal, infernal pixels, KG branding and a lovingly overdramatic rejection animation — all designed for the real **320×170 Cardputer Zero** display. 🦾🔥

### ⚠️ BEFORE YOU ENTER THE PORTAL
- **DOOM Zero is a launcher, not a bundle of commercial DOOM games.** Commercial WAD/game files are **not included**; provide game data you are legally entitled to use. 📂
- Game entries require compatible engines and the appropriate data files. The launcher reports missing data.
- Classic Chocolate Doom **does not support jumping**. 🚫🦘
- **DOOM 64 is not supported** in this version.
- This is an **unofficial community-made project**, not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, Bethesda or the DOOM rights holders.

**CREATED BY KiloGramowy 🔥**

**RIP AND TEAR — AND TRY TO REMEMBER YOUR OWN NAME!** 😈🔥🎮
